title: Assumption-lean post-integrated inference with surrogate-control outcomes

split.decision: Per-instance PII; frozen exact author DGP. Public validation seeds 100..119; 50 independently secret-generated evaluation instances; observations only, no latent U or instance seeds in inputs. No reusable training.

baseline.paper_ref: Fig.4 row 1 n=100 sigma_eps=0.8: manifest power 0.5118; exact archived 50-rep aggregation 0.51180405525106, reproduced with zero per-rep discrepancy.

allowed_changes: Surrogate-control embeddings, nuisance working models and surrogate losses, semiparametric effect estimators, variance estimation, cross-fitting and valid p-value calibrations may change.
PCA, ECV-tuned forests and t(df=99) are baseline estimation/calibration choices; alternative methods must estimate/test the same logit-scale effect rather than change the estimand.

When retaining the supplied PII pipeline, changing only the variance ridge 1e-4, Lasso alpha=1e-4, r=10, crossfit=1, M=M0=25, M_max=100, max_depth 1/3/5, max_samples .25/.5/.75/1 or df=99 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Improve testing power for the specified logit-link direct-effect hypotheses using only observed covariates, binary outcomes and known surrogate controls.

The selected generalized partially linear/logit effect parameter and zero-effect hypotheses, observed X/Y and supplied 500 control indices define the scientific inference problem; latent U is not an input.
The complementary 500 tested outcomes, finite beta/positive sampling variance, valid two-sided p-values, power/type-I/BH-FDR rules and independent-instance protocol remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not change the link/scale to marginal mean association or another causal effect, use latent U/true coefficients, test the known controls as alternatives, or submit unrelated beta/variance/p-values.
No hidden-seed recovery, additional labeled simulations, per-instance truth lookup or changed BH/type-I/power definitions.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.

evidence.section: Section 2.2 and Section 4, especially lines 391-430 and 691-714
evidence.finding: Defines projected direct effects and selected logistic simulation; nuisance learners/embeddings implement estimation, and oracle-U methods are distinct comparators.
The selected baseline uses logit-link nuisance/effect estimation with surrogate-control embedding.
Checks output range and fixed power/error-rate aggregation; no fixed t calibration is necessary to define the hypotheses.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
